# Snowdon day walk

One long day on 19 July, up the Miners' Track and down the Pyg Track.

## Route

About 13 km with 750 m of ascent. We start from Pen-y-Pass at 8am and expect to be back by 4pm.

## Bring

- Boots with good grip
- Two litres of water
- A head torch, in case we are late

## Emergency contacts

- Club emergency phone, carried on every walk: 07700 900123
- Club first-aider: Tom Okafor, 07700 900456
- Mountain rescue: call 999, ask for the police, then mountain rescue
- Club secretary, not on the walk: Ann Price, 07700 900789
